tags.description: Tags that serve as arbitrary metadata attached to the object of a type

mode.description: This defines what pkg contents are available for App and how pkg content can modified. see {@link AppMode} options.

waitSpec.description: Specifies various parameters for waitFor* actions.

name.description: Name of C3 Application to create and start; if not provided then sanitized root package name will be used instead

waitForReadyInternal.description:
Decision to wait for App to be ready to serve background tasks or internal calls.
If there are any critical issues found, startApp will throw error.

waitForReady.description:
Decision to wait for App to be ready to accept external API calls. If there are any critical issues found,
startApp will throw error.

doNotThrowOnIssues.description: If set to true, do not throw any critical seed issues found, when waiting for app to be ready.

serverVersion.description: Semantic version of the server that rootPkg depends on

autoScale.description: Decision to start task nodes of a task node pool with autoscaling enabled

taskNodeCount.description: Represents the number of {@link App.NodePool.Defaults#TASK} nodes to start for this App upon {@link Env#startApp}.

leaderNodeCount.description: Represents the number of {@link App.NodePool.Defaults#LEADER} nodes to start for this App upon {@link Env#startApp}.

nodePoolConfig.description:
List of {@link App.NodePool.Config} for an app. These {@link App.NodePool} config will get overridden
at app level upon app start. This allows configuration of {@link App.NodePool} before creation of app.

title: Specification for creating and starting a C3 Application
name: Env.StartAppSpec
